{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    payload = case['payload']
    segments = payload['segments']
    budget = payload['budget']
    sum_min = sum(s['minimum'] for s in segments)
    sum_cap = sum(s['capacity'] for s in segments)
    if budget < sum_min or budget > sum_cap:
        raise ValueError('Budget infeasible')
    alloc = {s['name']: s['minimum'] for s in segments}
    remaining = budget - sum_min
    while remaining > 0:
        best_score = -1.0
        best_index = -1
        for i, s in enumerate(segments):
            cur = alloc[s['name']]
            if cur >= s['capacity']:
                continue
            score = s['importance'] / (cur + 1)
            if score > best_score or (score == best_score and (best_index == -1 or i < best_index)):
                best_score = score
                best_index = i
        seg = segments[best_index]
        alloc[seg['name']] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    total_used = sum(alloc.values())
    names = [s['name'] for s in segments]
    return {'allocations': alloc, 'segments': names, 'total': total_used}"}
